Use when the user asks what's new or trending in AI tools, MCP servers, or indie software, or what people launched today or this week. Each product may include an MCP endpoint URL, mcpVerified (whether FastDrop's probe succeeded), and mcpAuthRequired when the endpoint answered 401/403.

tools.name: find_tools
tools.title: Find tools
tools.description: Find an MCP server or AI tool that can do a job. Use when the user asks for a tool, MCP server, or integration for a task ('is there an MCP for Stripe?', 'something that can scrape websites', 'what can I connect to Claude to send email?'). Searches the real tool lists FastDrop read from each server via tools/list, not marketing copy, so a match means the capability exists. Query in plain capability words, e.g. 'send transactional email' or 'query postgres'; each result lists the matching tools.

tools.name: list_reviews
tools.title: List reviews
tools.description: List reviews for a live FastDrop product by its slug. Returns the average rating, total count, and individual reviews (rating, body, author, date). Unauthenticated - available to any agent.

tools.name: list_comments
tools.title: List comments
tools.description: List comments for a live FastDrop product by its slug, as a two-level tree (top-level comments and their replies). Removed comments appear as a {deleted: true} tombstone. Unauthenticated - available to any agent.

tools.name: get_engagement_feed
tools.title: Get engagement feed
tools.description: Live FastDrop launches that need attention right now - launches by makers who actively support others first, then fewest votes first, zero-review items flagged. The participation loop: Vote on, review, or comment on 3 different launches in the last 7 days: your live launches are shown first to other makers in the engagement feed (get_engagement_feed), and a submission still in manual review moves to the front of the queue. With auth, the feed is personalized (your own launches and already-voted items excluded, tag-matches with your launches ranked first), each item says whether it needs a vote (toggle_vote) or a review (post_review), and the boost object reports your progress. Unauthenticated callers get the generic feed.

needs.description: toggle_vote when the launch has reviews, post_review when it has none

tools.name: get_launch_day_status
tools.title: Get launch day status
tools.description: Where a live product stands on today's FastDrop board (UTC day): rank, qualifying votes today, the launch one place above, votes needed to pass it, and hours left. If you manage the product, also your review-queue boost progress.

rankToday.description: Null until the first qualifying vote today

rankedToday.description: Launches with a qualifying vote today
